设置个人网站发布流程: Set Up Your Website Publishing Workflow
三步连接站点，之后可以随时在设置中修改。: Connect your site in three steps. You can change these settings at any time.

一次扫描派生总览、文章分组与问题详情: One scan derives the overview, article groups, and issue details.
当前筛选下没有待处理的文章问题。: No article issues need attention for this filter.
首次推送后，到 GitHub 仓库的 Pages / Actions 确认构建状: After the first push, check the build status in Pages / Actions on GitHub. Future article deployments will be tracked in publishing history.
在远端 diff 审阅中导入文章或复制 diff: Import articles or copy diffs from remote diff review
首次推送会提交生成的 Starter 文件，并推送到 origin 的目标分支。: The first push commits the generated starter files and pushes them to the target branch on origin.
Manifest 缺少截图说明。: The manifest is missing screenshot descriptions.
沉淀跨文章、跨站点复用的想法、片段、文章雏形和附件素材。: Collect ideas, snippets, article drafts, and attachments for reuse across articles and sites.
已有证据但清单未勾选: Evidence exists but the checklist is not checked
当前正文没有可引用段落: The current article has no paragraphs to reference
当前草稿与来源快照在主要字段上无差异（标题、Slug、摘要、标签、分类、发布状态: The current draft matches the source snapshot in all major fields (title, slug, summary, tags, categories, publishing status, and body length).
只做文章发布需要的 Git：路径规则、diff 摘要和发布准备。: Use only the Git features needed for publishing: path rules, diff summaries, and publishing readiness.
这些规则会随当前 Profile 进入 AI 聊天、元数据建议、发布检查、选区编: These rules follow the current profile into AI chat, metadata suggestions, publishing checks, selection editing, and image alt/caption suggestions.
把多个手机版 AI 动作串成一次可执行的写作、发布或维护流程。: Combine multiple mobile AI actions into one executable writing, publishing, or maintenance workflow.
修改 CSS 后会实时应用到预览区。可使用 `.markdown-content: CSS changes are applied to the preview in real time. You can use the `.markdown-content` selector.
保存 Token 后在这里检查当前仓库是否具备写入权限，并复制上架或发布排查需要: After saving the token, check whether the current repository is writable and copy the evidence bundle needed for release or publishing diagnostics.
发布后可在每条记录上手动检查部署状态；线上发布成功后会自动检查一次。: After publishing, you can check deployment status from each record. A successful online publish triggers one automatic check.
这会从工作台移除「%@」，不会直接删除本地仓库里的文件。: This removes “%@” from the workbench without deleting files from the local repository.
%@ 张 · 缺 alt %@ · 重复 %@ · WebP %@ · 缩放 %: %1$@ images · Missing alt %2$@ · Duplicates %3$@ · WebP %4$@ · Resize %5$@
将删除「%@」及其 %@ 篇草稿；可在本次会话中通过“撤销删除”恢复。: This deletes “%1$@” and its %2$@ drafts. You can restore them with Undo Delete during this session.
内置 %@ 个模板，支持新建站点或导入已有仓库。: %@ built-in templates support creating a new site or importing an existing repository.
另有 %@ 篇文章会在确认后导入。: %@ additional articles will be imported after confirmation.
GitHub/GitLab 会优先读取 Pages 与构建状态；Netlify: GitHub/GitLab checks Pages and build status first. Netlify reads the latest deploy after you provide a Site ID and token. Vercel, Cloudflare Pages, and custom platforms use the status endpoint or site URL configured here for post-publish verification. A Bearer token is sent only when status endpoint authorization is enabled.
先分析内容，再确认导入。原始文件、图片与仓库都不会在预览阶段被改写。: Analyze the content before confirming the import. Source files, images, and the repository are not modified during preview.

手动复用部署状态、站点/文章页检查、内容健康与链接审计。: Reuse deployment status, site/article checks, content health, and link audits manually.

高级调试用：启动本地 HTTP 接收器或粘贴平台 Webhook JSON，写入: For advanced debugging: start the local HTTP receiver or paste platform webhook JSON to add deployment snapshots and history to the latest publishing record. For normal publishing, use manual checks or deployment polling.
维护报告包含内容日历、标签治理、旧文整理、内链机会和链接审计。为避免打开健康页时: The maintenance report includes the content calendar, tag governance, stale-content cleanup, internal-link opportunities, and link audits. Details load only after you click, avoiding an immediate recalculation when the health page opens.
没有可写入的发布记录。: No publishing records are available to write.
当前分支未设置 upstream: The current branch has no upstream
本地 Webhook HTTP Receiver 和手动 JSON 注入，仅用于: The local Webhook HTTP Receiver and manual JSON injection are only for debugging deployment callbacks. For routine publishing, use polling above or Check Deployment on an individual record.
请先启动并检测本地预览服务器。: Start and verify the local preview server first.
支持 jpg、png、webp、gif、svg、heic、tiff、avif: Supports jpg, png, webp, gif, svg, heic, tiff, and avif
集中检查本地化、UI runtime、截图证据、App Store checkl: Review localization, UI runtime, screenshot evidence, the App Store checklist, and product boundaries in one place.
预览会转换 Front Matter、Slug、图片目标路径和重定向候选，但不会: Preview converts front matter, slugs, image target paths, and redirect candidates without copying files or accessing the network.
还没有 AI、线上发布或批量发布的免费版/Pro 边界记录。: No Free/Pro boundary records for AI, online publishing, or batch publishing yet.
设置 upstream 后，这里会审阅远端待拉取的文章、图片和配置变化。: After setting an upstream, review pending remote changes to articles, images, and configuration here.
用于上架材料、隐私审计和调试；日常只需要上方锁定和遮挡开关。: For release materials, privacy audits, and debugging. For daily use, the lock and masking controls above are sufficient.
批量检查封面、发布路径、alt/caption、本地源图、重复引用、裁剪缩放、J: Batch-check covers, publishing paths, alt/caption text, local source images, duplicate references, crop and resize, JPEG compression, WebP conversion, and SVG optimization.
当前文章还没有图片附件。: The current article has no image attachments yet.
支持 WXR、RSS/Atom、JSON 导出、单篇 Markdown 与 Ma: Supports WXR, RSS/Atom, JSON exports, individual Markdown files, and Markdown folders.
当前 Profile 没有可纳入发布队列的文章。: The current profile has no articles eligible for the publishing queue.
当前工作树没有变更。: The current working tree has no changes.
确认后会新增或更新本地草稿；不会自动写入仓库。: After confirmation, local drafts will be added or updated. Nothing is written to the repository automatically.
内容日历、标签治理、旧文整理、内链机会和链接提示已并入全站检查，作为低频治理报告: The content calendar, tag governance, stale-content cleanup, internal-link opportunities, and link tips are included in site-wide checks as a low-frequency governance report.
点击生成后才会扫描内容日历、标签、旧文和链接，避免打开页面时自动重算。: Content calendar, tags, stale articles, and links are scanned only after you click Generate, avoiding automatic recalculation when the page opens.
沙盒核验、上架证据、边界验证和最近访问记录，仅用于调试与审核准备。: Sandbox verification, release evidence, boundary validation, and recent access records are only for debugging and review preparation.
当前 upstream 没有待拉取的文件变化。: The current upstream has no pending file changes.
检查 GitHub Pages / Actions、GitLab Pipelin: Check GitHub Pages / Actions, GitLab Pipeline, Netlify, Vercel, Cloudflare Pages, or a custom status endpoint.
迁移计划只改写文章中的引用；图片本体仍需复制或下载到目标目录。: The migration plan only rewrites references in articles. Image files must still be copied or downloaded to the target directory.
导入 WordPress、RSS、Markdown 和通用博客导出包，先生成可审: Import WordPress, RSS, Markdown, and generic blog export packages, then generate a reviewable conversion plan first.
追踪本地写入、Review、线上提交、部署状态和回滚计划。: Track local writes, reviews, online commits, deployment status, and rollback plans.
复用正文编辑器的 AI 能力，适合先放进聊天输入框，发送前继续补充要求。: Reuse the article editor’s AI capabilities by placing the request in the chat box, where you can refine it before sending.
部署 Token 与仓库 Token 使用独立的钥匙串项；切换部署平台后需要保存: Deployment and repository tokens use separate Keychain entries. After switching deployment platforms, save a token for that platform. A legacy shared token is migrated automatically only for compatible GitHub/GitLab Pages configurations.
按手机版的 AI 修复队列逻辑，优先处理缺摘要、缺 Tags 和可由 AI 辅助: Following the mobile AI fix-queue workflow, prioritize missing summaries, missing tags, and metadata issues that AI can help evaluate.
维护报告尚未生成。: The maintenance report has not been generated yet.
还没有锁定、解锁或设置变更记录。: No lock, unlock, or settings change records yet.
